definition.description: Integrated deterministic benchmark across crop, plot, cycle, environment, scenario, sensitivity and ensemble dimensions

limitations: Synthetic outputs qualify software behavior only.
No real agronomic dataset is verified.
Sensitivity and ensemble spread do not establish identifiability.
No calibration, experimental validation, or data assimilation is performed.
